title: The Alliance That Invited Ruin
intro: Imagine being sheltered under the same roof as revelation, yet choosing a different loyalty. This figure lived intimately close to truth and prophethood, but turned toward those who rejected it. Their story stands as a solemn warning that nearness to righteousness alone cannot save a soul that betrays the trust.
clues: I lived in the household of a prophet chosen by Allah.
I knew the truth my husband preached, yet I did not truly believe it.
I betrayed his trust by siding with his rejecting people and aiding them against him.
I am mentioned alongside another prophet's spouse who also betrayed, as an example for disbelievers.
My story is told in Surah At-Tahrim as a warning that kinship to prophets gives no protection.
I perished with the wrongdoers when Allah destroyed the people of Lut, left behind with those who remained.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: The Wife of Prophet Lut
Asiya, the Wife of Pharaoh
The Wife of Imran
Sarah, the Wife of Prophet Ibrahim
The Wife of Al-Aziz

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Betrayed the prophet by aiding the disbelievers against him
Cast an infant into the river in a basket to save him
Demanded a golden calf be built during the prophet's absence
Accused a righteous minister of wrongdoing and imprisoned him
Led an army of elephants to destroy the Kaaba
trial.answer: Betrayed the prophet by aiding the disbelievers against him

location.label: Key Element
options: The overturned cities of Lut's people
The Ark built under divine command
The fire made cool for Ibrahim
The cave of refuge for sleeping youths
The river where the infant's basket was found
location.answer: The overturned cities of Lut's people

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Perished with the disbelievers despite marriage to a prophet
Was saved with the believers and entered Paradise in peace
Was turned into a pillar as a sign for later generations
Was swallowed by the earth with immense treasures
Was granted a miraculous child in old age
outcome.answer: Perished with the disbelievers despite marriage to a prophet

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
